Free · Works offline
Little steps, together.

Choose a picture

A real photo can make a step familiar.
Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP picture.

One step at a time

Choose a ready-made routine or make your own. Tap a picture to replace it, and change the words underneath.

First → Then or My steps

Use two pictures for a short routine, or add up to six steps. Switching to First → Then shows the first two pictures. Extra steps are kept for My steps.

Show it to your class

Choose Show to class to hide the editing controls. Children can tap a finished step. Tap it again to undo the check. Use Start again to reset the same routine.

Save and reuse

Save board downloads a board file with its pictures and words. Use Open board in this tool to bring it back, including on another device. Keep the Picture Steps HTML file too—it works without internet.

This is a teacher-led visual tool with no automatic narration. Your photos are processed on your device. No account or upload to a server is needed.
